latest_release.name: v0.14.2-beta
latest_release.body:
#### Important: New authentication system was added in [v2.26.0](https://github.com/advplyr/audiobookshelf/releases/tag/v2.26.0). See https://github.com/advplyr/audiobookshelf/discussions/4460 for details.

### Added

- Arabic, Hebrew, Slovak and Korean language options

### Fixed

- **(Android)** Crash on app start up #2023 by @nichwall in #2027

### Updated

- More strings translated
  - Bengali by @ShamiaAkterShanta
  - Czech by @CZDanol
  - Danish by Kim Josefsen
  - French by J. Lavoie
  - German by J. Lavoie
  - Greek by J. Lavoie
  - Italian by J. Lavoie
  - Lithuanian by @Haya25
  - Norwegian Bokmål by @Mediokris @oddhap
  - Persian by @AmirDehestani
  - Polish by @TheMatrixan
  - Spanish by @JnBenites
  - Swedish by Daniel Nylander

### Internal
- Add weblate translation credit workflow by @nichwall in #2022

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/advplyr/audiobookshelf-app/compare/v0.14.1-beta...v0.14.2-beta
